checkpoints.description: [1/1] Replace the default thinking prompts with one-sentence directive prompts in the prompt stage

impact_assessment.why: Coder 1.5B tune: none of the 21 thinking prompts beat the format-directive baseline; the user asked for directive-style prompts
impact_assessment.benefits: The prompt stage tries instructions small models can act on
impact_assessment.risks: contract: default prompt step list changes, saved tune-grid.json files keep their own lists; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: existing profiles keep their chosen prompt
impact_assessment.mitigation: THINKING_PROMPTS stays exported; tests pin the new list; ADR-036 records it

checkpoints.description: Directive prompts in; 290/290 tests, gate 4/4; checklists: passed
Task 'directive-prompts-v1' completed successfully.
[1/1] Keep the system message when the engine sets a session's chat history

impact_assessment.why: setChatHistory replaced the constructor's system message, so no system prompt ever reached the model; every tuned prompt tied
impact_assessment.benefits: Chat, benchmark and tune answers use the chosen system prompt
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, chat API unchanged; dependency: relies on node-llama-cpp getChatHistory; concurrency: none; state: profiles tuned before measured without a system prompt and should be re-tuned
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first engine test mirroring node-llama-cpp; real-model check; ADR-037 tells to re-tune

checkpoints.description: Fix in; 292/292 tests, gate 4/4, real-model check; checklists: passed
Task 'system-prompt-fix' completed successfully.
[1/2] Suite v10 adds 30 own math and 40 own recall items; [2/2] rungs grow to 12/24/48 so tune choices rest on more items

impact_assessment.why: Tune scores rested on 11-24 items per task, so no difference was significant (p 0.375-1); the user asked for enough items for proper statistics
impact_assessment.benefits: Every task offers at least 51 items and the final rung scores up to 48, so McNemar can separate real gains
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SUITE_VERSION 10 marks saved profiles stale with a warning; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: tunes take about twice as long per stage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Answers verified by independent tests; generated recall items deterministic; ADR-038 records cost and staleness

[1/1] Suite v11 adds 12 items on three larger codebases (ledger, orders, markdown)

impact_assessment.why: The user wants a coder that works well in complex codebases; v10 had only 12 codebase items on small projects
impact_assessment.benefits: 24 codebase items across six projects, larger ones with six or seven files
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SUITE_VERSION 11 marks saved profiles stale with a warning; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: code task grows to 112 items
impact_assessment.mitigation: References, shipped-bug failures and culprit probes verified in tests; ADR-039

[1/1] Part runs re-measure chosen stages or settings for one or all models on top of the saved rest, with per-part fingerprints

impact_assessment.why: The user wants to run one part (device probe, one setting, the prompt stage) for all models; chosen done stages were skipped and Run all wiped stale profiles
impact_assessment.benefits: Device-only, setting-only or prompt-only runs across all models keep every other result, and warnings name the parts still measured on an older suite
impact_assessment.risks: contract: planTune returns rerun and allows part runs on stale profiles (ADR-034 refusal lifted); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profiles gain an optional measuredUnder map
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first profile and server tests; real device-only run on a stale profile kept the rest; ADR-040
